title: Design the feedback loop, not just the UI
principle: Julie Zhuo’s public writing (The Looking Glass / Making of a Manager themes): product quality depends on how teams give feedback, set expectations, and grow judgment. For AI design ops, specify critique cadence and decision owners—not only screens.
procedure: Name who decides vs who advises.
Set a critique format (goals, constraints, questions) before showing work.
Timebox feedback; end with explicit decisions.
Separate taste notes from blocking issues.
Log decisions so AI iterations don’t reopen settled calls.
examplePrompts:
Design the feedback loop (Zhuo / Looking Glass leadership craft):
- Decision owner
- Critique agenda template
- Blocking vs non-blocking labels
- Decision log format
Apply before the next AI visual pass.
Convert this sprawling Slack critique into decisions + owners; discard re-litigation.
promptWhy: Decision log stops AI churn from reopening calls.
tips: Public essays/talks; paraphrase leadership craft—not a full book reprint.
